tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Diagram and page background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Toolbar, legend, tooltip and interface-circle fill; node fills are mixed onto it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Node labels, message labels, titles. 15:1 on canvas and on every role fill in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Edge labels, technology lines, captions, legend text. 5.9:1 (light) and 7.6:1 (dark) on canvas.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Default relation stroke and arrowheads (uses, part_of, deployed_on). 3.7:1 / 6.4:1 on canvas.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Frame borders, dividers, swimlane edges. Decorative only, never carries meaning.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Stroke of primary elements and arrowheads. Systems, applications, data stores, queues, behaviour (states, steps). The brand's lead hue.

tokens.name: primary-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of primary element boxes; `ink` text on it.

tokens.name: primary-group
tokens.usage: Fill of primary containers (compounds, layer bands).

tokens.name: primary-ink
tokens.usage: Text in the primary colour (container titles) on canvas and on `primary-group`; ≥4.6:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Stroke of secondary elements and arrowheads. Components, data objects, cloud zones, compute nodes, networks.

tokens.name: secondary-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of secondary element boxes; `ink` text on it.

tokens.name: secondary-group
tokens.usage: Fill of secondary containers (compounds, layer bands).

tokens.name: secondary-ink
tokens.usage: Text in the secondary colour (container titles) on canvas and on `secondary-group`; ≥4.6:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Stroke of tertiary elements and arrowheads. Hardware (ECUs, SoCs, buses) and detailed design (UML classes).

tokens.name: tertiary-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of tertiary element boxes; `ink` text on it.

tokens.name: tertiary-group
tokens.usage: Fill of tertiary containers (compounds, layer bands).

tokens.name: tertiary-ink
tokens.usage: Text in the tertiary colour (container titles) on canvas and on `tertiary-group`; ≥4.6:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Stroke of accent elements and arrowheads. Interfaces, decisions, sequence fragments, selection highlight. Never a layer colour.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of accent element boxes; `ink` text on it.

tokens.name: accent-group
tokens.usage: Fill of accent containers (compounds, layer bands).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text in the accent colour (container titles) on canvas and on `accent-group`; ≥4.6:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Stroke of neutral elements and arrowheads. Actors' surroundings: external systems, platforms, requirements, swimlanes.

tokens.name: neutral-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of neutral element boxes; `ink` text on it.

tokens.name: neutral-group
tokens.usage: Fill of neutral containers (compounds, layer bands).

tokens.name: neutral-ink
tokens.usage: Text in the neutral colour (container titles) on canvas and on `neutral-group`; ≥4.6:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Stroke of critical elements and arrowheads. Status only: risk, open, deprecated. Never decorative.

tokens.name: critical-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of critical element boxes; `ink` text on it.

tokens.name: critical-group
tokens.usage: Fill of critical containers (compounds, layer bands).

tokens.name: critical-ink
tokens.usage: Text in the critical colour (container titles) on canvas and on `critical-group`; ≥4.6:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: on-strong
tokens.usage: Text on solid role bars: bus and network bars (filled with the role's `-ink`) and the sequence fragment tag (`accent-ink`). ≥4.6:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus and selected element ring, 2px solid; ≥4.6:1 on canvas in both themes.

tokens.name: layer-context
tokens.usage: Role of the context layer; elements of this layer take the `primary` family unless their type overrides it.

tokens.name: layer-application
tokens.usage: Role of the application layer; elements of this layer take the `primary` family unless their type overrides it.

tokens.name: layer-component
tokens.usage: Role of the component layer; elements of this layer take the `secondary` family unless their type overrides it.

tokens.name: layer-design
tokens.usage: Role of the design layer; elements of this layer take the `tertiary` family unless their type overrides it.

tokens.name: layer-behaviour
tokens.usage: Role of the behaviour layer; elements of this layer take the `primary` family unless their type overrides it.

tokens.name: layer-platform
tokens.usage: Role of the platform layer; elements of this layer take the `neutral` family unless their type overrides it.

tokens.name: layer-infrastructure
tokens.usage: Role of the infrastructure layer; elements of this layer take the `secondary` family unless their type overrides it.

tokens.name: layer-hardware
tokens.usage: Role of the hardware layer; elements of this layer take the `tertiary` family unless their type overrides it.

tokens.name: layer-trace
tokens.usage: Role of the trace layer; elements of this layer take the `neutral` family unless their type overrides it.

tokens.name: rel-flow
tokens.usage: Data-flow relations (flows_to).

tokens.name: rel-connect
tokens.usage: Physical connections (connects) between hardware and buses.

tokens.name: rel-trace
tokens.usage: satisfies relations to requirements.

tokens.name: rel-decide
tokens.usage: decides relations from decisions.

tokens.name: rel-highlight
tokens.usage: Edges in a highlighted neighbourhood.

styles.name: diagram-title
styles.usage: Title above a diagram or artboard.

styles.name: group-label
styles.usage: Container and layer-band titles, in the role's `-ink` colour.

styles.name: edge-label
styles.usage: Relation labels, transition events, message names.

styles.name: id
styles.usage: Element IDs in tooltips and tables.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Label to its mark; icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inner gaps in chrome; label padding on edges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Node inner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Container padding to children; minimum gap between boxes.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Diagram margin inside its frame.

tokens.name: node-sep
tokens.usage: Layout gap between siblings in one rank (ELK spacing.nodeNode).

tokens.name: rank-sep
tokens.usage: Layout gap between ranks (ELK nodeNodeBetweenLayers); ×1.6 when edges carry labels.

tokens.name: seq-col
tokens.usage: Distance between sequence lifelines.

tokens.name: seq-row
tokens.usage: Distance between sequence messages.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Toolbar buttons, search field, fragment tag.

tokens.name: radius-node
tokens.usage: Element boxes.

tokens.name: radius-group
tokens.usage: Containers, legend, diagram frame.

tokens.name: radius-zone
tokens.usage: Cloud zones (region, VPC, cluster): the only strongly rounded container.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Frames, lifelines, swimlane borders.

tokens.name: stroke-node
tokens.usage: Element and container borders, default relations.

tokens.name: stroke-strong
tokens.usage: Physical connections (connects), risk status border.

tokens.name: node-min-width
tokens.usage: Minimum element box width; grows with the longest label line.

tokens.name: node-min-height
tokens.usage: Minimum element box height.

tokens.name: iface-size
tokens.usage: Interface lollipop diameter.

tokens.name: bus-height
tokens.usage: Height of bus and network bars.
